decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Drawing Numbers AH-1-AH-9, Photo P1, Design and Access Statement received 21/08/13 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Removal of one pair of the existing set of three pairs of glazed doors and adding a brick wall infill , addition of an internal wooden door, internal walls adjacent to the proposed door which are curved are replaced with straight walls and replacement of the existing timber decking with pale stone slabs
